{{Quote|She downed a TIE Interceptor, and, on foot on an alien world, fought the pilot.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] describes [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] downing and killing the pilot to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Unidentified Rebel technician (Redemption)|technician]].|<ref name="SW1" />}}
A '''Human''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] as part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the battle they served as a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] pilot on board a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] which was sent to the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]] to attack a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] scouting party which was attempting to find a new base for the Alliance. Once the Star Destroyer arrived in the system the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] immediately launched from the Destroyer and flew out against the Rebels, who were piloting [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. The pilot and a number of other Interceptors engaged the X-wings in a dog fight above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dominus III]]. During the fighting one of the Rebel pilots, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the Imperial pilot were caught in the blast of a missile, which caused enough to damage to force them to try and land on the planet.

Organa crashed first and quickly left her ship to chase the Interceptor to its crash site. Once the pilot crashed and attempted to leave his burning vehicle, she was ready for them and shot the Imperial in the chest, knocking them to the ground before they could shoot. Organa then shot the pilot several more times killing them. After the pilot's death Organa and the other rebel pilots, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] who had landed on the planet to find Organa, burned the pilot's ship to prevent the Empire using the ship's [[transponder]] to find them.<ref name="SW1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot appeared in the [[Star Wars (2013) 1|first issue]] of the comic book series [[Star Wars (2013)|Star Wars]] by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The series was written in [[Brian Wood]] and illustrated by [[Carlos D'Anda]], it was published on [[January 9]] [[2013]].
